messages:
Sophie-Sales: Hey team — DataBridge (channel partner) wants to run a joint co-sell POC next week. They asked for a short architecture doc, who owns infra vs data, how we handle keys/KMS, and an initial cost split for the pilot. Can @Raj-Eng and @Mia-Partnerships help coordinate? Need to answer security questionnaire and provide a demo env.
Lisa-Partner: Thanks Sophie. We’re fine with a week-long sandbox POC. Proposed model: Redwood-hosted inference endpoints + DataBridge app calling them over VPC peering. Data stays in their Snowflake account, we only receive masked payloads. We can share network diagram and a minimal config.
Lisa-Partner: Quick sketch:
```
Network: VPC peering (partner <-> redwood-vpc)
Auth: OIDC between DataBridge IdP and Redwood (SP)
Keys: Customer KMS for Snowflake side, Redwood KMS for runtime keys (no shared plaintext)
```
Raj-Eng: That architecture looks good. For the POC we can provision a dedicated small pool with strict access logs. Need DataBridge to fill the security questionnaire for SSO domains and IP ranges. I can stand up the endpoints and preconfigure an inference route.
Raj-Eng: minimal curl for testing once we have creds:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-7b", "input":"hello"}'
```
Mia-Partnerships: I'll run the partner enablement session and collect the security questionnaire. Also will coordinate pricing ask — DataBridge wants a 60/40 split (partner/revenue). We should ask Sales Ops for guidance. @Sophie-Sales can you flag a target ARR for the deal to see if that split makes sense?
Sophie-Sales: Target ARR for the pilot -> $0 (evaluation), long-term target is $120k ARR if conversion. For pilot we should propose 'platform credits' from Redwood and partner covers integration engineering. Recommend finance approve 70/30 once deal phases in. cc @Owen-Solutions for SLO considerations.
Owen-Solutions: For POC success we need clear SLOs: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 512 tokens, availability 99.5% during demo. Also define dataset sizes and QPS. If DataBridge intends to hit higher QPS, we need to pre-warm batching.
Lisa-Partner: Agree on SLOs. We'll ask their engineering lead to provide expected QPS and typical sequence lengths. For the security questionnaire: they want contact for SOC2 attestation and an IP allowlist. Can Redwood provide SOC2 doc and a short IP range list? @Raj-Eng
Raj-Eng: Yes — I’ll attach SOC2 link in the shared drive and provide the NAT IP ranges. For KMS, if they require customer-managed keys, we can accept encrypted payloads and decrypt only in the customer's VPC in Private mode — but that needs Redwood Private or Dedicated. For hosted POC, we can use tokenized inputs (no raw creds).
partners-bot: Shared runbook created: https://drive.redwood.ai/partnerships/databridge-poc-runbook (includes checklist, security questionnaire template, and network diagram). :spiral_note_pad:
Mia-Partnerships: Checklist I’ll own: 1) Security Q filled, 2) Sandbox creds issued, 3) Enablement session scheduled, 4) POC success criteria agreed, 5) Finance sign-off for credits. When is everyone available for a 30-min kickoff? Propose Monday 10am PST.
Sophie-Sales: Monday 10am PST works for me. I’ll invite DataBridge SE and their CISO. Please mark action items in the runbook before that meeting.
Raj-Eng: I’ll provision a temporary dedicated pool and preseed a small sample model with prefix caching enabled. ETA: 24 hours after kickoff creds. Will post endpoint and test token in runbook (temp token will be rotated).
Lisa-Partner: Also need a short enablement slide (10 slides) showing joint flow and how attribution will work for co-sell credits. I can draft and share before the kickoff. :thumbsup:
Owen-Solutions: One ask from my side — if they want reranking or embeddings in the POC, call it out now so we can pick model variants. Embeddings change pricing profile.
Sophie-Sales: Noted. DataBridge asked for contextual reranking on demo, include that in the questionnaire. Mia, flag that in the checklist.
Mia-Partnerships: Flagged. I’ll update the runbook with an ‘embeddings/rerank’ checkbox and request sample dataset. Closing note: this thread will be the place for all artifacts — runbook link + final SOC2 + SOW. Keep replies short in thread and push heavy docs to the runbook.
